About Me

I’m a Creative Technologist and Product Designer who builds digital tools that are both expressive and useful. I’m completing a Master of Creative Computing at Southern Methodist University (expected Spring 2027). I also hold a BS in Psychology with a minor in Business Management from the University of Houston. I work across JavaScript, p5.js, Processing, D3.js and 3D tools to prototype ideas quickly, from interactive visuals and data stories to product concepts. Psychology helps me understand users, business helps me think about impact, and code lets me build the answer. I’m looking for roles in creative technology and product where I can turn complex problems into clear, human-centered experiences.
